output.summary: An evergreen perennial native to mountainous Central and Southern Europe and Asia Minor. It has glossy leaves and drooping yellow-green spring flowers, often edged with purple; its foliage smells pungent when crushed. All parts are poisonous and can cause violent vomiting and delirium.
output.edibilityNote: All parts are poisonous; eating the plant can cause violent vomiting and delirium.
